title: The Mad Monk: Reincarnation of the Dragon

overview: Inspired by the novel Last Days by Adam Nevill, Ascension follows Rose, a relentless documentary filmmaker and recently divorced mother, brilliant at uncovering others' truths but struggling to resolve her own. When Rose begins a project on a mysterious 20th-century cult known as the Church of Ascension, she finds unexpected refuge in its teachings – until she discovers something far more insidious beneath.
title: Ascension

overview: Their paths crossed as children. Years later, a tragic incident brings Aslan and Elvan together again, forcing them into a marriage of convenience built on sacrifice and duty. At the same time, the heroes must contend with the intrigues of their relatives and pressure from influential circles.
title: Tut Elimi

overview: After tragedy shatters a small Minnesota hockey town, a grieving wife steps behind the bench of the team her husband built, guiding a found family of wounded young athletes through a season of loss, love, and rivalry that will decide whether South Dorothy has anything left to believe in, and who will lead it into its next chapter.
title: The Sticks

overview: The series takes place in the fall of 2018. Three Ukrainian warships depart from the Black Sea to Azov, performing a planned transition through the Kerch Strait. During the passage, Ukrainian crews are attacked, and 24 sailors are captured. The next 286 days they will spend in Moscow Lefortovo. Despite the psychological pressure, interrogations and attempts to force Ukraine to renounce Ukraine, none of the sailors refused to take the military oath. How and why did they survive? What role did the families of prisoners and their lawyers play in this struggle? And what really happened behind the walls of Lefortovo? The answers to these questions are in the events of the series 24.

Dalliance follows retired cameraman Billy who unexpectedly crosses paths with chef Dani. An instant connection threatens to unravel decades of friendship and family. As one life-changing event sends shockwaves through an entire community, marriages are tested, new relationships ignite, old wounds resurface, and everyone is forced to confront the choices that have shaped their lives.
title: Dalliance

overview: The Shen family is massacred, and young Shen Li witnesses Zhao Wujiu, Cui Hong, and a mysterious figure with a man-eating flower tattoo committing the murders. After narrowly escaping death with Xie Yungui's help, she takes the name Gu Hanyi and masters both medicine and strategy. Joining forces with other women, she carefully sets her revenge in motion. But after eliminating two of her enemies, she is shocked to discover that the third has been by her side all along...
title: Hanyi Enters the Heart

overview: "I can has cheezburger?" That simple, grammatically incorrect question launched an Internet phenomenon known as lolcats, pictures of cats or other animals with funny phrases superimposed on the images. LOLwork is a reality series that follows the employees at Cheezburger, which runs ICanHasCheezburger.com (ICHC) and more than 50 similar sites. The staff is led by CEO Ben Huh and includes his wife, Emily, who is the editorial chief for ICHC. Other employees include Will, a cat lover who acts as the company's content supervisor (aka censor) to make sure that every cat on the site receives the respect it deserves. So next time your boss catches you looking at a picture of a cat eating sausage links with a funny caption on it, he'll know who's to blame -- Ben Huh and his staff.
title: LOLwork

overview: The program is dedicated to the history of Russian rulers. Historical chronicles and literary works are used to reconstruct events from centuries ago. Alexander Mikhailovich Panchenko is one of the leading scholars of our time, the author of classic works on the humorous culture of ancient Rus', on Russian culture on the eve of Peter the Great's reforms, and numerous articles on Old Russian literature.
title: Русские цари

overview: Comedy TV series from the creators of "Ostorozhno, Modern!" with Dmitriy Nagiyev and Sergey Rost in the lead roles.
title: Полный модерн!

overview: The life of a top actress Wen Jianan collapses overnight. Witnessing her father He Mu commit a murder in the ancestral home, she flees in panic. However, she gets into a premeditated car crash and gets framed as the killer, leaving her disgraced, destitute, and under house arrest in a sanatorium by her own mother. Meanwhile, Jiang Yu, the mystery owner of Cloudsea Club, infiltrates her side as a rehabilitation therapist, with the aim to avenge his mother. During the hunt, he finds out that the real murderer is her father, and the two are actually half-siblings. After intense probing, manipulation, and suspicion, they recognize their common enemy and form a revenge alliance, setting traps to unravel shocking family scandals. When all sins are exposed and the truth comes to light, the two forge the sincerest bond and embrace a fresh start.
title: Dearest

overview: In never-before-heard prison calls recorded before his death, convicted killer Charles Manson reveals the twisted motivations for his gruesome crimes.
title: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes

overview: Salty Coffee begins with the intersection of the paths of Gözde, the daughter of one of Istanbul's established and wealthy families, and Mehmet, the heir to a holding company who has returned from America. The young couple, eager to marry, bring two families, seemingly incompatible, face to face.
title: Tuzlu Kahve

overview: Revisits homeowners to see how they are faring after selling their unsellable homes with the help of property experts.
title: Inside Selling Houses Australia: New Beginnings

overview: MTV2, MTV's sibling network, today announced the debut of "Fear Factor" producer David A. Hurwitz's new series "numbNuts", a high octane, hilarious, adrenaline-fueled stunt competition game-show series, on Friday, September 28, 2012 at 10:00 p.m. ET/PT, immediately following the season seven premiere of the "Bellator Fighting Championships" at 8:00 p.m. ET/PT on MTV2. The series is executive produced by Hurwitz ("Fear Factor," "Stars Earn Stripes") and directed by Rupert Thompson ("Fear Factor," "Wipeout," "Stars Earn Stripes"). Pitting Internet-contestant's stunt mishaps against three web-celebrity Stunt Masters - Crazy Mike, The Horse and Victor Lopez - the series will feature comedian and host Jeff Dye overseeing the two teams battling it out to see who can better perform steroid-injected versions of the stunts. With bodies crashing, sliding, colliding, and flying through the air- "numbNuts" is a win big or lose hard competition that hilariously walks the line between stupidity and bravery.
title: numbNuts

overview: The son of a deceased police officer, the talented con artist Bayun, faces a choice: to make a deal with his father's friend, Colonel Rubin, or go to prison. Bayun chooses the deal and becomes a "freelance consultant" in the Samara Department of Special Investigations (OSR), headed by Rubin. Using his unconventional approach as a con artist, Bayun helps his new colleagues solve one case after another.
title: Крот Баюн

overview: Comedian Marie Faustin, hosts as singles face outrageous challenges, reveal their biggest red flags, and fight for a shot at love!
title: Why Are You Single?

overview: A mysteriously restless and indefatigable man who painted incessantly as if always sensing the brevity of the time he had left, Amadeo navigates an intense romance with Lucie and an explosive artistic career among the modernist avant-garde of Paris and Portugal before the ravages of World War I and the 1918 pandemic cut his life short at age thirty.
title: Amadeo
Ke Fou Xu Wo Zai Shao Nian

overview: In the coastal town of Caramirim, the three surfer sisters of the Jequitibá family fight for the region's environmental protection. But Violeta wants to build a hotel complex there.
title: Três Irmãs

overview: The Detour with David Chang follows the acclaimed chef, restaurateur and author in his pursuit of no-frills but unforgettable eats on the open road. In the age of influencers, algorithms and listicles, Chang cuts through the noise on a classic American road trip following local leads and friends' recommendations to his next meal. Each episode represents a different leg of Chang's journey, pairing him with a new travel companion and a new culinary adventure.
title: The Detour with David Chang

overview: Adapted from Yi Shu's novel of the same name. A young woman's glamorous life shatters when she is suddenly imprisoned, only to discover that the romance she trusted was built on lies and schemes. Betrayal turns love into hatred, igniting her desire for revenge. When the bitter bloom finally fades, will she be left with ruin or a chance to begin again?
title: After the Bloom

overview: For over 150 years, New England ports have been beacons in America's commercial fishing history. Today, the fishermen that venture into the Atlantic compete to reel in the biggest catches and largest paychecks, as they struggle to keep their towns and traditions alive.
title: Nor'Easter Men

overview: Yu Jiuqi, an adopted daughter, falls in love with Sun Xi, the son of her family's sworn enemy. Bound by a decades-old blood feud, guilt forces them apart. Three years later, Sun Xi returns, reigniting both their buried love and lingering hatred. Beneath the freezing northeastern winter, they pretend to be strangers while secretly drawn to each other. Can love finally break the cycle of vengeance?
title: Back to Life

overview: Over the course of the first Halloween special, the famous faces will use every ounce of their comedic talent to break their opponents without laughing or screaming. And it's not just their rivals they need to watch out for. Cursed props, ghostly interruptions and spine-tingling surprises are all designed to catch even the bravest comic off guard. The rules are simple: laugh and you're out, scream and you're out. Who will survive Last One Laughing: Halloween?
title: Last One Laughing: Halloween

overview: The star of the capital accidentally finds himself drawn into a high‑profile crime in a provincial town. The actor has to join forces with a police major who takes on the case while nine months pregnant, not only to save her reputation but also to unravel a whole tangle of lies.
title: Почти настоящий детектив

overview: Bar owner Bob uses his sister, violinist Christina, who is addicted to drugs, to transport "white poison". Taking advantage of the sympathy of the artist, a special agent of the organized crime department, police major Georgiy Ivanovich, nicknamed Titanic, is introduced into the gang of drug dealers. He gets a job as Christina's bodyguard. A penchant for improvisation unexpectedly leads him to a situation where he has to choose between duty and conscience.
title: Возвращение Титаника

overview: The hero of the multi-part television series remains the good-natured and unremarkable-looking Titanic, a UBO agent. But appearances can often be deceiving, and Titanic is a clear example of this. He is fearless, intelligent, and cunning. He is a skilled psychologist. He has an unusually developed intuition. In his work as an undercover agent, he constantly takes risks, improvises, and at times seems more like an adventurer, which, incidentally, creates great difficulties for his superiors and colleagues. He received his unusual nickname precisely for these qualities, which often lead Titanic into hopeless and dangerous situations in which he "sinks." But, unlike the infamous ocean vessel, our Titanic invariably emerges victorious from all conflicts. Now he has been assigned to establish contact with a major leader of a regional criminal group nicknamed Nikei, who is running for governor of Russia's richest region. The crime boss's chances of winning are increasing with each passing day. Titanic's mission is to arrange for Nikey to be arrested red-handed for some specific illegal act, preventing him from running for office and simultaneously decapitating the organized crime group. The agent devises a highly ingenious method of infiltrating Nikey's inner circle, quickly winning his favor, and becoming the bandit's confidant...
title: Возвращение Титаника-2

overview: Russians and Italians need to get to know each other anew. Immerse themselves in the true Italian reality, and see the face of a true Italian. After all, behind the stereotypes and cliches that every traveler knows, lies a country that is immeasurably more profound and interesting.
title: Настоящий итальянец

overview: The protagonist of the 16-episode comedy drama is Maxim, a race car driver. Amateur motor racing is an integral part of his life. Maxim owns a car repair shop. He manages a team of true professionals – three of his friends and his son, Boris. Just when the business is up and running, Maxim's wife, Lisa, files for divorce. Not only is her husband obsessed with cars, but he's also taken a mistress, a famous radio host!
title: Реальные кабаны

overview: Shahrzad narrates stories from the Arabian Nights, a collection of folk tales that brims with great morals, fascinating characters, flying carpets, magic lamps and fairies.
title: Alif Laila

overview: Kathy is a one-hour weekly pop culture talk show hosted by two-time Emmy winner Kathy Griffin. Every Thursday night, the original gossip girl will have a whole hour to deflate the egos of everyone who is anyone and those who think they're someone. Kathy will showcase Griffin's unique take on celebrities, co-workers, friends, politicians, and yes, even her own boxed-wine swilling mother, Maggie. She'll be burning the last of her already very few bridges, all while enforcing a clothing optional work environment.
title: Kathy

overview: The series centers on prosecutor Fang Wei and follows a team of prosecutors as they pursue truth and justice through a series of complex cases. The main story revolves around Wei Feng, who is suspected of sexually assaulting and murdering Li Ran. Fang Wei joins forces with Xu Yishan, Chang Kaixin, and Zhou Yan to investigate the case. Despite numerous obstacles—including the suspect retracting his confession, pressure from the families involved, and intense public scrutiny—the team carefully pieces together the evidence and ultimately uncovers the conspiracy behind the crime. Alongside the central case, the series features several other investigations, including Zhou Yumei's murder of her husband, the Zhao Nanfeng murder case, the case involving Luan Pingping, and Cui Xiangqin's attempt to frame others through her suicide. As Fang Wei works to uncover the truth, he also faces personal and professional challenges that push him to grow. Together with his team, he remains committed to the principles of law and the pursuit of justice. Through these interconnected cases, the series portrays a group of dedicated prosecutors who stand firm under pressure and remain determined to uphold fairness and justice.
title: Unvoiced

overview: To retrieve the *Manual of a Hundred Demons*, a motley crew ventures into the human world; through the interconnected tales of various demons, they reflect the realities of human life and the complexities of the human heart.
title: Bai Yao Pu

overview: Hayley Pearson, Lauren DeCesare and Tom Rehn bring a fresh new look to Sunday. Get all the tips for a short holiday or day out and start the week right with Hello SA.
title: Hello SA

overview: In Ashbourne Falls, Harold hides in plain sight, a quiet man with a dark compulsion to kill. Mabel, a disgraced nurse, moves through life with a dark secret. This is the story of two killers destined to collide.
title: Serial

overview: The King of Baghdad, Shaharyar after being deceived by his wife had decided to marry a girl every day and kill her the very next day. He was angry and he wanted to kill every female alive. His minister's daughter, Shaharzad decided to marry him first in order to save other female's and to trick him with a bunch of stories. She convinced him to listen to her stories which were of Alif-Laila.
title: Alif Laila

overview: Two disillusioned 30-somethings carry out their teenage pact - a platonic marriage - to satisfy family and societal expectations.
title: Settling

overview: Kwon Do Hyeok, the emotionless CEO of SY Entertainment, has everything except peace of mind. Haunted by long-standing PTSD and crippling insomnia, he seeks help from a psychiatrist, who gives him an unusual prescription: find a woman whose voice can calm his nerves before his condition worsens. When an indie band's album lands on his desk, Do Hyeok hears a voice that instantly feels familiar—the same voice that once comforted him in his darkest moments. Determined to find the mysterious singer, he soon discovers that his father has also set his sights on her. As Do Hyeok races to find her first, his empty, emotionless life spirals into an unexpected romance, awakening feelings, and obsessive tastes he never knew he had.
title: What a Boss Wants

overview: Things rarely change, but everything began to change. Eun-tae, who has been working as an ordinary employee, is burnt out from everything that happens to him. Everything from work to relationships with others, his life is filled with boredom. Suddenly, he becomes a lottery winner and gets 1.3 billion won. While it is a huge amount, realistically, it is hard for him to even purchase his own house in Seoul. After reviewing everything, he decides to live his life as he used to, but with a somewhat different mindset, as he has "insurance" that he can depend on.
title: The Ordinary Jackpot

overview: A retired chef's plans for a peaceful life are disrupted when his youngest son is defrauded of a large sum of money. Though not legally responsible for the debt, he sells his home and returns to work to help his son repay it.
title: A Father's Debt

overview: A look inside the training gym that is dedicated to business professionals.
title: Fight Night

overview: Beach Sisters follows beach volleyball sisters Anouk and Zoé Vergé-Dépré through their first season as teammates on the road to the 2028 Olympic Games, offering exclusive insights into their lives as they balance elite sport, family, and personal challenges. After years of competing against each other, Anouk and Zoé are now united on the sand as one team. The documentary captures their journey as they strive to establish themselves among the world's best, highlighting not only their triumphs and setbacks on the court, but also the unique bond they share as sisters, and the physical and mental demands of life as elite athletes competing around the globe.
title: Beach Sisters

overview: A chaotic three-person family unexpectedly finds themselves navigating high school together in the exact same classroom. The fast-paced series combines laugh-out-loud comedy with heartwarming dynamic shifts as parents and child attempt to survive everyday school life, strict teachers, and peer pressure under one shared roof—and one shared desk setup.
title: We Are Family

overview: Get an exclusive look at the New England Patriots with never-before-seen access inside the walls of Gillette Stadium.
title: Forged in Foxborough

overview: Peacock NBA Monday is an exclusive weekly streaming broadcast block on Peacock featuring up to three live regular-season NBA games every Monday night, preceded by a dedicated 30-minute pre-game studio show.
title: Peacock NBA Monday

overview: Coast 2 Coast Tuesday is an NBA on NBC prime-time doubleheader format featuring an eastern/central regional game at 8:00 p.m. ET followed by a late-night western matchup starting at 11:00 p.m. ET (or 8:00 p.m. PT), bridging coast-to-coast basketball action across NBC and Peacock.
title: Coast 2 Coast Tuesday

overview: The Retrievals follows an unlikely community of IVF patients who come together to crusade against Yale University after they are operated on without anesthesia–because a nurse stole their fentanyl.
title: The Retrievals

overview: Good Rain Knows Its Season follows an aloof architect and a resilient single mother who both survived personal betrayals, finding quiet healing together in Dali.
title: Good Rain Knows Its Season

overview: A weekly guide on where to go and what to do in the capital city.
title: London Go

overview: Bound by a system to play a cold CEO's dutiful wife after a fatal accident, Ye Ningle endures five years of emotional neglect while he chases his first love. When her mission finally concludes, she demands her freedom—only for her indifferent husband to realize too late that he cannot let her go.
title: Let's Get A Divorce, Miss Ye Can't Bear It Anymore

overview: A powerful CEO and a struggling actress from opposite worlds are forced into an unlikely partnership to rescue a company in crisis. As they fight to rebuild its reputation, old betrayals and lingering resentment resurface, putting both their fragile partnership and their chance at redemption to the ultimate test.
title: Honor Thy Mother

overview: What is the truth lying beneath our feet? Michael Sheen uncovers claims of conspiracy, complicity and denial over alleged toxic 'forever chemical' contamination in South Wales.
title: Buried with Michael Sheen

overview: After being contacted by arms dealer Peter Frederiksen, a pair of journalists find themselves unraveling a harrowing global crime spree.
title: Et monsters bekendelser

overview: Zhang Tianyou, heir to the ancient dragon-seeker lineage, enters the world of tomb raiding as a live-in son-in-law, maneuvering among the four great families. His journey leads him back to the Tide Tomb, a place of mystery from twenty years ago. Through deadly mechanisms, thread puppets, hallucinogenic poisons, restless spirits, and a woman's coffin, he pieces together the truth that will change everything.
title: My Years as the Dragon-Seeking Master

overview: When a brilliant misfit discovers the secret to beating casinos at their own game, she's pulled into a world of obsessive outlaws who all live by one rule: the only way to beat the system is to outplay the people who built it.
title: Advantage Player

overview: A rare insight into the environments that shaped Norway: the wars between the men who ruled the streets, the headlines that dominated the media, and the lives that were lost.
title: Brutalt brorskap: Oslo

overview: An overwhelmed group of teenagers struggles to run a local pizzeria while juggling school, a manic boss, and minimum wage salaries. The stakes are low, and the pressure is immense.
title: Minimum Wage

overview: Jimmy Bullard and Kiri Bloore discuss the weeks hottest sports stories.
title: Jimmy Bullard Kicks Off

overview: Valley Hills is a perfectly nice California suburb… unless you're like Olivia, who has lived in New York City her whole life. When her parents split up, Olivia is suddenly the new kid at Valley High, where she meets horse girl Taylor and influencer Riley. Freshman year comes at them fast, with false starts, first kisses, and family drama — but together these unlikely best friends will find their place in the sun.
title: Sunshine Girls

overview: Sid is a seductive, sophisticated, and amoral teenager from New York, sent to live with a police chief and his family in the idyllic Mississippi town where his mother grew up. Among them is the chief's sharp-witted, punk-rock daughter, Zoey. Resisting their mutual attraction, Sid and Zoey find themselves drawn into a dark, hidden world beneath the town's picture-postcard facade — and a paranormal puzzle that may well get them killed (if they don't kill each other first). It's a fish-out-of-water tale focused on an unlikely pair with plenty of scares.
title: Sid & Zoey

overview: Kraken receives a mysterious call demanding he find a valuable book; if he fails, his mother will be killed. The catch? His mother has been dead for decades. Alongside his inseparable partner Esti, he must unravel a complex case filled with suspense, action, and emotion.
title: Kraken. El libro negro de las horas

overview: Vascular surgeon Neil Hopper becomes a symbol of hope after losing both legs, until an investigation uncovers a hidden obsession and secret life.
title: An Amputation Obsession: The Monster and the Surgeon

overview: A series of specials across the BBC featuring Steve Coogan's character Alan Partridge.
title: Alan Partridge BBC Specials

overview: A series of specials across Sky featuring Steve Coogan's character Alan Partridge.
title: Alan Partridge Sky Specials

overview: True crime influencer Kara Chamberlain investigates unsolved murders and missing persons cases that have long stumped both professional and amateur sleuths.
title: Somebody Knows Something

overview: A harrowing two-part documentary chronicling how a mother of five suddenly found herself being sold to unknown men... by her own partner
title: Sexslaven

overview: Children's magazine programme with music, competitions and fun.
title: Dè a-nis?

overview: Oswald the Lucky Rabbit, one of Disney's earliest characters who predated Mickey Mouse, is back for the 21st century.
title: Oswald

overview: Out of the mists of oracles emerge spectres of the future. Throughout history, mystics, soothsayers, haruspices, and harbingers of doom have dealt out dispatches from beyond the veil. What ineffable materials made their predictions possible?
title: Oracles & Prophets

overview: Sand and deliver! In beautiful St Andrews, Iain Stirling challenges sand sculptors to create magical masterpieces - before the waves crash in. But only one team can take the crown.
title: Race Against the Tide
Ming Ming Jiu Shi He Jiu De Guan Xi

overview: Norway has eight sites on the UNESCO World Heritage List. Join Silje Nordnes on a journey of discovery through Norway's World Heritage.
title: Vår verdensarv

overview: A young chef is successful in every aspect of his life owing to a secret: he possesses the extraordinary ability to read other people's minds. Another young man who has a chronic condition—a fear of being stared at by others, which causes him to make mistakes in everything he does. They both end up working at the same place, and a series of chaotic and humorous events unfolded when they sleep together, resulting in a special transfer of energy. From someone who was always confident to someone who was always afraid of people—how will they solve this problem?
title: Taste of Love

overview: In the race to save lives, every second counts. Witness up close how a team comes together to care for A&E's most critically ill patients.
title: Emergency 24/7

overview: The definitive background to the abduction and murder of toddler James Bulger, which shocked the nation in 1993, and continues to resonate to this day.
title: The Killing of James Bulger

overview: Sport Science is where science meets sports in this informative documentary series. Created by the masterminds behind National Geographic's Flight Science, this ESPN project tests established athletic theories and theories using advanced technology. Originally airing on the ESPN family of Networks now airing on their sister family of Networks as a part of their parent company owned by Disney and the Disney family of Networks.
title: Disney XD ESPN Sport Science

overview: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?
title: Take a Hike!

overview: An intimate, raw portrait of Manchester City FC across two era-defining seasons. With unprecedented access, the film follows their worst run in decades and fightback to glory.
title: A Beautiful Obsession

overview: At his clinic, sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse and intimate sexual issues with sincerity. Yet, he secretly hides a struggle of his own.
title: S&X

overview: The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.
title: LION

overview: Frank is not just a dad - he's also a high school teacher. But when his daughter Jonna gets her father as her teacher, she decides to drop out.
title: Pappas flicka

overview: If the world as we know it came to an end, what would you do? Our modern world exists on a knife edge, but if the worst happened, the fight for survival won't be in jungles, forests or desert islands. It'll be in the towns and cities we call home. In this bold and ambitious social experiment, Channel 4 is sending a group of ordinary people to a jaw dropping, real world location - an abandoned town that bears all the hallmarks of being ravaged by an apocalyptic event. They'll have to survive for 28 days without running water, heating, or electricity. They'll need to scavenge for food and supplies, reusing and repurposing anything they find but only if they can muster skills and wherewithal to do it. Nothing here comes easy, and in the face of scarce resources will this unlikely group of strangers band together or fall apart?
title: Apocalypse

overview: Meeting the men redefining what it means to be a modern man of today, Sam & Pete: Dying to Look Good will explore trends including looksmaxxing, and the lengths many go to to achieve physical perfection, t-maxxing (testosterone boosting) and biohacking, an insight into the anti ageing obsessives who are determined to turn back the clock. From bonesmashing to bodybuilding, cryotherapy to cosmetics, Sam and Pete will immerse themselves in the surprising and at times shocking universe of male self improvement, giving audiences an access all areas insight into the men taking bold steps in their quest for perfection.
title: Sam & Pete: Dying to Look Good
